findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子：Hubbell 使用的鋼、鋁、銅及零組件、成品來自加拿大、中國、墨西哥與歐洲；進口關稅已或可能推高成本，並可能引發他國報復性關稅，影響需求與利潤。
findings.excerpt: We utilize materials (such as steel, aluminum and copper), components and finished goods that are sourced from or manufactured in foreign countries, including Canada, China, Mexico and countries in Europe. Import tariffs and potential additional import tariffs have resulted or may result in increased prices for these imported goods and materials

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 MD&A：2025 年毛利率擴張中，材料與其他成本通膨（含關稅費用）造成約三個百分點的收縮，被價格與生產力抵銷。
findings.excerpt: The increase in gross profit margin includes approximately four percentage points of margin expansion driven by favorable price realization, improved operational productivity, and lower acquisition-related intangible amortization expense, which was partially offset by three points of margin contraction due to material and other cost inflation, including tariff expense.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子：出口管制與制裁法規可能限制出口或需出口許可，違規有罰則；一手文件未點名具體管制清單事件。
findings.excerpt: Moreover, any changes in export control or sanctions regulations may further restrict the export of our products or services, and the possibility of such changes requires constant monitoring to ensure we remain compliant.
